title: Two Sports Fans
两个体育迷

sentences: Tony was having a rest in the sports centre when he met Stacy.
托尼在体育中心休息时遇到了史黛西。
"Stacy, you skate so well!
「史黛西，你滑冰真好！
Are you good at skateboarding as well?"
你也擅长滑板吗？」
"Thanks Tony, I'm into sports on rolls and boards, like skating, skateboarding, snowboarding and skiing.
「谢谢托尼，我喜欢轮滑和板类运动，比如滑冰、滑板、滑雪板和滑雪。
But I like riding bicycles the most." Stacy said with a smile on her face.
但我最喜欢骑自行车。」史黛西带着微笑说。
"Wow.
For me, I'm a big fan of ball games.
对我来说，我是球类运动的狂热粉丝。
Football, basketball and volleyball are the three most famous ball games in the world, but I'm more interested in some 'small balls'."
足球、篮球和排球是世界上最著名的三大球类运动，但我对一些「小球」运动更感兴趣。」
"Baseball, my favourite sport, is very popular in America and Japan.
「棒球，我最喜欢的运动，在美国和日本非常流行。
Table tennis and badminton are popular in China."
乒乓球和羽毛球在中国很受欢迎。」
"And tennis is well known in the world!
「而且网球在世界上很有名！
My mum is a successful tennis player and she won the first prize in one of the Olympic Games.
我妈妈是一位成功的网球运动员，她在其中一届奥运会上获得了一等奖。
She gave me a racket.
她送了我一个球拍。
But it's really hard for me to play tennis."
但对我来说，打网球真的很难。」
"Cricket, golf and ice hockey are also very popular.
「板球、高尔夫和冰球也很流行。
You can try them."
你可以试试。」
"You are really a young expert in ball games, Tony.
「你真是个球类运动的年轻专家，托尼。
But I'm afraid the cricket bat is too heavy to play long.
但恐怕板球球棒太重了，打不了太久。
I can try golf and ice hockey.
我可以试试高尔夫和冰球。
In addition, it's very important to prepare sports kit before we do sports, such as swimsuits for swimming, a pair of special shoes for climbing and a life jacket for sailing."
另外，在做运动前准备运动装备非常重要，比如游泳用的泳衣、登山用的专用鞋和帆船用的救生衣。」
"Right.
「没错。
We also need litres of water and several kilos of chocolate in case of energy loss."
我们还需要几升水和几公斤巧克力，以防能量流失。」
"Kilos of chocolate?
「几公斤巧克力？
Sure?
确定吗？
Fifty grammes, that's enough."
五十克就够了。」
"Sorry, I'm also a big fan of chocolate." Tony and Stacy laughed happily.
「抱歉，我也是巧克力的大粉丝。」托尼和史黛西开心地笑了。
